desc:
🐾 Care for adorable pets by day, then follow the House Rules to survive the night!

You're the new pet sitter. Every night a new family leaves you their pet and a note of strange HOUSE RULES. Feed them, brush them, walk them, play with them... and do exactly what the note says.

Because after dark, things start to feel wrong. 🌙
Two kittens on the sofa when there should be one. A knock at the door with nobody there. A tall man in a hat, watching through the window.
Break a rule and you'll wake up by the door.

Spooky but cute: cozy pet care with a creepy twist. 👻

🏡 30 nights, 30 houses, 30 adorable pets
📜 New strange rules every night
👀 Spot the anomalies before it's too late
🐶 Every pet you save moves into YOUR home
🦮 Walk them down Pet Lane to Paw Park
🐎 Teach tricks & ride your pets
🛋️ Decorate your home, garden & mansion
👫 Pet sit with friends, ring their doorbells & show off your pets
🌙 A new night unlocks every day!

Can you keep your pets safe until 6 AM?
